name: The Shoppes At Chino Hills
summary: The Shoppes at Chino Hills is a modern outdoor lifestyle center featuring palm trees, fountains, and a compelling mix of brand-name retailers, diverse dining options, and wellness services. This community-focused destination combines convenience with an upscale shopping experience, hosting regular events and serving as the premier gathering place in Chino Hills.
demographics: The Shoppes at Chino Hills attracts an affluent suburban demographic, primarily consisting of families and professionals from the surrounding Chino Hills area, which is known for its higher-than-average household incomes and well-educated residents. The trade area draws middle to upper-middle class shoppers, typically aged 25-55, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. Visitors tend to be homeowners with children who appreciate the outdoor setting and mix of national retailers, dining options, and service providers that cater to their lifestyle needs.
description: The Shoppes at Chino Hills stands as Chino Hills' premier shopping and dining destination, where community, convenience, and lifestyle converge in a beautifully designed outdoor setting. This modern lifestyle center features palm trees and fountains throughout, creating an inviting atmosphere for shoppers seeking both retail therapy and culinary experiences. The center boasts an impressive mix of national retailers including Banana Republic, Barnes & Noble Booksellers, Bath & Body Works, and LensCrafters, alongside specialty boutiques like Brighton Collectibles, Francesca's, and Lovesac. Dining options are equally diverse, ranging from California Pizza Kitchen and Chipotle Mexican Grill to Gusto Italian Bistro and the specialty coffee offerings at Klatch Coffee and 7 Leaves Café. Beyond shopping and dining, the center serves as a community hub with services including European Wax Center, Club Pilates, Massage Heights, and professional offices, while also hosting regular community events like the Downtown Art Gallery on Wednesday and Friday evenings, reinforcing its role as the heart of Chino Hills' social and commercial life.
